thread:
liz: FYI AuroraMesh (acct: AM-309) just hit `card_decline` on INV-2026-0459 for $12,400 (due 2026-03-02). CS says vendor delayed their receivables; they're asking for a 3-way split (today, 14 days, 30 days) and no service suspension while on the plan.

kevin: Paste the invoice and recent payment attempts pls. any prior history?

liz: Invoice snippet: ```
invoice: INV-2026-0459
amount: 12400.00
due: 2026-03-02
status: unpaid
attempts: 1 (card_decline 2026-03-06)
past_dues: none in 12mo
customer_note: vendor receivable delay; requests 3 installments
```

priya: Legal: we require a signed installment agreement and card auth for the final installment. We can allow a 3-installment plan but we need explicit SLA language if we won't suspend service.

maya: Ops: we can agree to hold suspension while the plan is active but only for one missed installment; if 2 installments miss we will suspend. Need that written into the plan.

kevin: Risk check: usage pattern looks stable and ARR small. I'd be ok with 3 installments but require manual review if second payment fails. Also recommend an ACH fallback option if card fails.

billing-bot: ALERT: account AM-309 flagged - PAYMENT_ACTION_REQUIRED for INV-2026-0459. Next retry scheduled 2026-03-10.

liz: Customer asked explicitly to waive any late fee. Can we offer a one-time waiver contingent on signing and providing a backup ACH or card?

priya: We can approve a one-time waiver of the standard 6% late fee, provided: 1) signed addendum, 2) backup payment method on file, 3) auto-collect enabled for installments. Add clause: "Waiver void if any installment is missed without cure within 5 business days."

maya: I'll prepare the `installment-agreement-v2` and include the SLA hold-off + waiver conditions. Draft message to customer: 

"Hi AuroraMesh — we can do a 3-installment split for INV-2026-0459: 33% due today, 33% in 14 days, 34% in 30 days. We'll waive the one-time 6% late fee once we receive a signed installment agreement and backup payment method. Service will remain active while the plan is current; two missed installments may result in suspension. Please sign here: <link>. Once signed we'll send the first installment invoice."

kevin: Sounds good. Also include that if the final installment fails, we'll attempt ACH fallback and then open a collections case after 7 days.

collections-bot: LOG: possible_payment_plan_offer_created by liz at 2026-03-07T09:14:11Z (plan_id: PP-2072-AM309). Status: pending_customer_signature.

ops: Note: don't change Dedicated or cluster configs; just annotate account status. We'll only trigger suspension via the normal ops playbook.

priya: Approve conditional waiver. Legal to be CC'd on signature email.

liz: I'll send the agreement and follow up with the CS rep. tagging checklist: `send-agreement`, `attach-backup-method`, `enable-auto-collect`, `set-collections-watch`.

kevin: If they decline the backup method, escalate to collections; don't do partial waiver without backup.

liz: Understood. I'll update thread once signed or if they push back. :thumbsup:
